desc: Implement KMP search function and occurrence lists for P1, P2, P3, handling empties.
Split pattern `p` into three literal parts: P1, P2, P3 based on the two '*'.
Compute L1 (start indices of P1), M2 (start indices of P2), R3 (end indices of P3) using KMP for non-empty patterns.
Handle all 8 cases based on which of P1, P2, P3 are empty (including all-empty case returning 0).
Use binary search (bisect) to find optimal l and r for each P2 occurrence in the all-non-empty case.
Iterate over M2 in Case A (all non-empty) and update answer with min length.
Handle Case B (P1 empty) by fixing l=m and searching for minimal r in R3.
Handle Case C (P2 empty) by iterating over L1 and finding minimal Q3 start ≥ l+|P1|.
Handle Case D (P3 empty) by iterating over M2 and finding maximal l in L1 with l+|P1| ≤ m.
Handle Cases E-H (two or three parts empty) with direct length calculations.
Return -1 if no valid match found, else min length.
Final review: The solution correctly covers all cases, uses O(n log n) time and O(n) space, fits constraints (n≤1e5).
